objective: Qualify a mainstream, sufficiently large, Haze4K- and SOTS-outdoor-disjoint RESIDE OTS source-scene pool for a synthetic-outdoor local optical-thickness measurement without importing the failed indoor q gate.

synthetic_outdoor_measurement.core_assumption: A disjoint OTS clear-scene pool with paired MATLAB v7.3 depth and full-factorial official haze variants can support a separately defined synthetic-outdoor local optical-thickness measurement.
synthetic_outdoor_measurement.close_condition: Close if the frozen outdoor field lacks scene-level reconstruction, local-heterogeneity coverage, precision, or permuted-depth negative-control separation.
